title: Boundary Thermalization in Superdiffusive Energy Transport
summary: We study energy transport in a finite one-dimensional unpinned harmonic chain with stochastic nearest-neighbor momentum exchanges and Langevin heat baths at its endpoints. Such systems are known to exhibit superdiffusive transport driven by long-wavelength acoustic modes, leading to fractional macroscopic behavior. While fractional heat equations have been rigorously derived for infinite chains, the corresponding boundary conditions for finite systems in contact with heat baths remain unclear due to the nonlocality of the fractional Laplacian.
